snippet.title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department) | Official Gameplay Preview (EN)
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914590/ADD_Anomaly_Detection_Department/

A.D.D. is a card-based strategy and management game where players take on the role of a manager overseeing expeditions into unknown areas for a company.

Players deploy employees, connect nodes across the board, and design exploration routes to determine how each expedition proceeds. Edgeblocks can be installed between nodes to alter the properties of a route and change the records and data produced during exploration.

The materials recovered from expeditions cannot be submitted immediately. Players must organize the resulting records, refine collected byproducts into the required data, and submit the completed results to the company.

As more employees, records, data, and nodes accumulate, the limited board space becomes increasingly difficult to manage. Decide which materials to preserve, which byproducts to discard, and how to prepare the board for the next expedition.

Explore, refine, and submit.

Producing the results the company demands is your job.

A.D.D. will be available for free on Steam on July 31.
